LanguageData.CC_Settings_DiplomacyTasks: Council tasks and the keeper of secrets
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_DiplomacyTasks: Officers take tasks with the neighbors: letters, patrols, visits by caravan. The keeper of secrets watches guests.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_DiplomacyTasks_Tip: Each of eight offices may take one task at a time at its home, set on the Decrees page's row for the office, on the officer's card, or from a people's card: the speaker wins a town's head over (letters every four to six days, an invitation, a visit; at a regard of 60 their people offer a pact or owe the colony a favor); the keeper of secrets learns a notable's secret (talks with their people here, a paid informer, a visit; found out one time in ten); the marshal walks the edges at dawn for a season (a raiders' camp seen sooner) or drills a defense pact partner's fighters (their band a fifth stronger for a season); the quartermaster opens a trade (letters, samples, a visit; their trade pact or their caravan); the physician takes medicine to a town with a sickness running (one visit in five brings it home); the warden of guests writes about the colony's own held elsewhere (a lower price for them) or about their kin in the colony's cells (offers sooner and higher); the chaplain keeps the faith with a head of the same faith or speaks for it to one of another; the steward prepares a feast (the guests' welcome counts half again). Visits go by caravan through the journey planner: the officer and a companion, at most one officer away from a home, each office once a season. The keeper of secrets also walks with guests after dark, and while the seat is filled the colony's secrets slip half as often. Off: nothing new is set, and an officer away still comes home.

LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_WinOver: Letters to a town's head every few days, an invitation, a visit once a season. At a regard of 60 their people offer a pact, or owe the colony a favor.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Secrets: Talks with their people when they come by, a paid informer, a visit. A secret learned can be pressed later. Found out one time in ten.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Scout: A walk along the edges at dawn every other day for a season. A raiders' camp nearby is likelier to be seen early.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Drill: A visit to a defense pact partner to drill their fighters. Their band comes a fifth stronger for a season.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Trade: Letters to their trader, samples of the colony's surplus, a visit. When the trade is open, their trade pact or their caravan.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Dues: The colony's own vassals bring their dues on time.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Tend: A visit with medicine to a town where a sickness is running. One visit in five brings it home.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_BringHome: Letters to the people holding one of the colony's. Their price for them comes lower.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_TheirKin: Letters to a people whose kin are in the colony's cells. Their offers come sooner and higher.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_KeepFaith: Letters to a head of the colony's own faith, and a visit. Their regard rises, and the believers at home are steadied.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_SpeakFaith: Letters to a head of another faith, and a visit. Their certainty is shaken a little, never past what the game's own conversion needs.
LanguageData.CC_Task_KindTip_Host: A letter to prepare, then the feast the council plans. The guests' welcome counts half again.

LanguageData.CC_Task_Confirm: Give {PAWN}, the {OFFICE}, a task among {WORD}: {KIND}, with {TARGET}?
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_WinOver: {PAWN} writes to {NAME} every four to six days (or calls, where both sides have the means), invites {NAME} to the colony once, and may visit once a season. Each letter warms {NAME} to the colony by {PAWN}'s Social. Once {NAME} thinks {GOAL} or more of the colony, their people offer a pact, or owe the colony a favor.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Secrets: {PAWN} talks with whoever of {NAME}'s people comes to the colony, can pay an informer at the gate, and may visit their town once a season. Each step pits {PAWN}'s Social and Intellectual against {NAME}'s. A secret learned ends the task, and the colony can press it later.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Scout: For a season, {PAWN} walks the edges of the colony's land at dawn every other day. A raiders' camp being set up nearby is likelier to be seen before its first raid.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Drill: {PAWN} goes to {NAME} and spends a day drilling their fighters. For a season after, their band comes a fifth stronger when the pact calls them.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Trade: {PAWN} writes to {NAME} every four to six days, can send samples of the colony's surplus, and may visit once a season. Each step counts by {PAWN}'s Social and Intellectual. When the trade is open, their people offer a trade pact, or send their caravan.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Dues: {PAWN} sees that the colony's vassals bring their dues.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Tend: {PAWN} takes medicine from the stores to {NAME} and spends a day with their sick. Their people remember it, and their head thinks better of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_BringHome: {PAWN} writes to the people holding {NAME}. After two letters they send word of a price for {NAME} to the gate, lower for each letter and for {PAWN}'s Social, down to half the usual.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_TheirKin: For a season, {PAWN} writes to {NAME} about their kin in the colony's cells. While {PAWN} writes, their offers for them come in half the time and a quarter higher.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_KeepFaith: For a season, {PAWN} writes to {NAME}, who keeps the colony's faith, and may visit. Each letter warms {NAME} to the colony, and a kind answer steadies the believers at home.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_SpeakFaith: For a season, {PAWN} writes to {NAME} about the colony's faith, and may visit. Each letter shakes {NAME}'s certainty a little. Words alone never bring {NAME} to the colony's faith.
LanguageData.CC_Task_How_Host: {PAWN} writes to {NAME} to prepare a feast for their people. Once they answer kindly, the council plans the feast, and the guests' welcome counts half again.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Confirm_Visit: A visit to their town can be planned on {PAWN}'s card once a season. {PAWN} goes by caravan with a companion, and the roads are the world's own.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Visit_Cost: {PAWN} and {OTHER} go by caravan to {TOWN} ({DISTANCE}), stay a day and come home. The journey is planned for the next morning in the journey planner, where it can be changed or called off. Their work waits while they are away, and the roads hold what they hold: raiders, weather, sickness.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Visit_CostAlone: {PAWN} goes alone by caravan to {TOWN} ({DISTANCE}), stays a day and comes home. The journey is planned for the next morning in the journey planner, where it can be changed or called off. {PAWN}'s work waits, and the roads hold what they hold: raiders, weather, sickness.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Risk_Secrets: One step in ten, {PAWN} is found out: {NAME} will think less of the colony and of {PAWN}, and say so at their next meeting.
LanguageData.CC_Task_Risk_Tend: One visit in five, the sickness comes home with them: one of the party falls ill with it on the road.
